REPORT ON Deportation of four Russians to Harbin

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by

Sir,

When entraining for Harbin on the morning of January
26 three packages of luggage, the property of Vassali
Rybtchinsky were placed in the care of the luggage clerk
outside the luggage van of the train and a luggage receipt
obtained, but on arrival at Nanking Ferry Station it was
found that the luggage had not been put on the train. I saw
Mr. Wayne, Traffic Superintendent of the Shanghai Nanking
Railway on February 4. He caused enquiries to be made and
it was ascertained that the luggage van was full in fact
out of twenty six packages checked only eleven were sent
by that train. The three packages were sent to Nanking
Ferry by the next train and have now been brought back to
Shanghai and are in the baggage room at the Shanghai North
Station. The hitch was caused purely by the excessive
amount of New Year traffic on the railway.

Mr. Wayne states that the Railway Company will
forward the baggage to Harbin if desired, but as the movements
of the deported men are uncertain, I respectfully beg to
suggest that it be kept in Shanghai for a time as the Chinese
Authorities in Harbin may communicate with the S. M. P. on
the subject and a definite address to which the baggage may
be forwarded may be obtained. Mr. Wayne says he will keep
the baggage at the Railway Station until further instructions
are received from the Police.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I.

D. C. I.

先生，

1月26日上午，在登上前往哈尔滨的火车时，瓦萨利·雷布钦斯基所有的三件行李被交由列车行李车外的行李员保管，并取得了行李收据，但在抵达南京渡轮站时，发现行李并未装上火车。我于2月4日会见了沪宁铁路局交通主管韦恩（Wayne）先生。他派人进行了查询，经查实，行李车已满，实际上在托运的二十六件包裹中，只有十一件由该次列车发出。这三件包裹由下一班列车运至南京渡轮站，现已运回上海，存放在上海北站的行李房内。此次延误纯属铁路新年期间客流量过大所致。

韦恩先生表示，如有需要，铁路公司将把行李寄往哈尔滨，但由于被驱逐人员的行踪不确定，我谨建议暂时将行李保留在上海，因为哈尔滨的中国当局可能会就此事项与上海公共租界工部局警务处联系，从而可以获得一个确切的地址以便寄送行李。韦恩先生说，在收到警方的进一步指示之前，他将把行李保留在火车站。

敬礼，
卑职，
D. I.

副刑事侦缉督察长

该轮于1月15日星期日上午8时许抵达，停靠在浦东开滦矿务局码头。探员 Givens 和 Sullivan、副探长 Kay 及华捕 Korolkoff 前往该轮，发现三名被驱逐者在船上，并有两名来自爪哇的警官陪同。这些人被拘留并关押在中央捕房，将于1月16日被提解至混合法庭。Zinovieff 称，他约14个月前经上海从海参崴前往爪哇，在荷属婆罗洲的荷兰政府下属担任测量员一职，约四个月前被送回爪哇。Zachartschinko 是一名机械工程师，也在爪哇和苏门答腊呆了约14个月，而 Rybtschinksky 是一名电气工程师，在那里呆了约15个月。后者称，他被赶出爪哇仅仅是因为失业，陪同这些人的警官除了要将他带到上海之外，没有关于他的任何信息或指示，且他的名字不在交给警方的文件上

January 14 1922

REPORT ON Passage through Shanghai of Russian Communists
deported from The Netherlands East Indies

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence,

Sir,

With reference to the expected early arrival here
of Russian Communists named Zinovieff, Zachartschenko and
Rytschinksky, who have been deported from The Netherlands
East Indies to Harbin for carrying on communist propaganda
amongst the natives of the former place, I attach herewith a
copy of a letter which the Associate Comptroller of the
Bureau for Russian Affairs has received from the Acting
Consul General for Holland in this connection.

Under the circumstances, it would seem advisable
to have the deportees kept in custody while in Shanghai and
accompanied by some member of the police when they resume
their journey to Harbin.

Mr. Chetverenko, Secretary of the Bureau of Russian
Affairs, who has brought this letter to the police, states
that his office is not in a position to advance the expenses
for the purchase of tickets to enable the deportees to
continue their journey,

I would therefore respectfully beg to apply for
instructions as follows :

(1) Shall steps be taken to secure the necessary
authority to detain the deportees while in Shanghai ?

(2) From what source will the necessary advance of
funds to enable the prisoners to continue their journey be
secured ?

(3) Shall a member of this Force be sent to accompany
the prisoners to ensure that they continue their journey ?

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）

D. C. I.

关于从荷属东印度群岛被驱逐的俄国共产主义者途经上海的报告

由 D. I. Givens 制作，经刑事侦缉处处长转呈，

先生：

鉴于名为 Zinovieff、Zachartschenko 和 Rytschinksky 的俄国共产主义者预计不久将抵达此处，他们因在前述地区当地人中进行共产主义宣传而被从荷属东印度群岛驱逐至哈尔滨，谨此附上俄事局助理稽核员就此事项收到的荷兰代理总领事来信副本。

在此情况下，似乎宜在被驱逐者身处上海期间将其拘留，并在他们恢复前往哈尔滨的旅程时由一名警员陪同。

将此信带给警方的俄事局秘书 Chetverenko 先生称，其办公室无力垫付购买车票的费用以使被驱逐者能够继续旅程，

因此，本人恭敬地请示如下指示：

(1) 是否应采取步骤以获得必要的授权，以便在被驱逐者身处上海期间将其拘留？

(2) 为使囚犯能够继续旅程所需的垫付款项将从何处获取？

(3) 是否应派遣本队一名成员陪同囚犯，以确保他们继续旅程？

先生，
您忠顺的仆人，
（签名）

副刑事侦缉处长。

Shanghai, January 11th, 1922.

No. S6

Sir,

Referring to your letter No. 1693 of
December 22nd last, I beg to inform you that having
communicated with the Government of The Netherlands
East Indies concerning the advisability of ensuring
the immediate continuance of the journey of the
Russian communists who are on their way to Shanghai,
I am now notified that the names of the three
undesirables are Zinovieff, Zachartschenko and
Rybtschinsky and that they are travelling on the
s.s. "Tjitam roem" expected to arrive at this port
on Sunday the 15th next at the earliest.

I am moreover instructed to defray the
expenses of tickets for the journey from Shanghai
to Harbin of the three above-named persons and
should be obliged if you would arrange for the
necessary measures being taken for their early
departure from Shanghai and render the account
for fares to this Consulate-General.

I am informing the Commissioner of Police
of the travellers' expected arrival and intended
departure.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

V. Grosse, Esquire,
Associate Comptroller of
the Bureau of Russian Affairs.
SHANGHAI.
Acting Consul General.

此外，我奉命支付上述三人从上海至哈尔滨旅程的车票费用，如蒙阁下安排采取必要措施使他们尽早离开上海，并将车费账单寄至本总领事馆，将不胜感激。
